title_en: AMD adds strength to domestic NPU ecosystem...Establishes R&D center in Korea
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] The government has decided to join hands with AMD in the AI ​​semiconductor field. This is to prepare for heterogeneous computing that goes beyond GPU-centered AI computing and combines various methods such as CPU and NPU. According to the Ministry of Science and ICT on the 27th, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Science and ICT met Lisa Su, AMD Chairman, and signed a memorandum of understanding for cooperation in the AI semiconductor and computing fields. AMD is a global semiconductor company encompassing CPUs and GPUs and recorded annual sales of $34.6 billion as of 2025, especially due to the increasing demand for CPUs and GPUs for servers. Thanks to this, data center business sales reached $16.6 billion, establishing itself as a major company in the AI computing market. In particular, it is pursuing the expansion of the AI computing ecosystem based on ROCm, an open source software platform, and open standards. Through this, we are actively working to create an open AI infrastructure ecosystem by participating as a founding member of UALink, an open high-speed AI semiconductor connection standard, along with several global companies such as Google, Apple, and Microsoft. Recently, the global AI semiconductor market has moved away from a single GPU-centered computing structure to a heterogeneous computing architecture due to increased demand for inference due to the spread of generative AI and agentic AI.

title_en: Disney Plus, live broadcast of Major League and LOL competitions
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Disney Plus will present Major League Baseball (MLB) and League of Legends (LoL) competitions to Korea in real time. Disney Plus announced on the 27th that it has signed an agreement with sports channel SPOTV and will introduce fandom content to Korea, including MLB live broadcasts, the 2026 LoL KeSPA CUP, and global music festivals. SPOTV will broadcast major MLB regular season and postseason games starting on the 27th. It will be presented in real time until October. It offers a variety of regular season games, including Korean player team games, one game a day. Expanding collaboration with the Korea e-Sports Association, all games of the LoL KeSPA Cup, Korea's only LoL short-term cup competition, are being broadcast live globally exclusively. All matches will be broadcast live every Monday and Tuesday from the preliminaries to the finals on August 18. In the tournament, which opened on the 20th, 10 teams from LoL Champions Korea (LCK), including T1 and Gen.G, compete for a total prize money of 52 million won. Disney Plus Korea's official SNS channel posted greeting videos of participating teams, information about the tournament, and pre- and on-site content. The music lineup will also be expanded. Following the Bonnaroo Music and Arts Festival last June, LoL, a large American music festival, will be held from the 31st to August 3rd.

summary_source: [지디넷코리아]신한투자증권이 디지털자산 인프라 투자에 나섰다.신한투자증권은 블록체인 네트워크인 ‘캔톤 네트워크’ 운영사 디지털에셋에 투자했다고 27일 밝혔다. 투자금액은 비공개다. 이번 투자는 가상자산 전문 펀드 a16z가 주도한 3억 5500만 달러 규모 펀딩 라운드에 참여하는 방식으로 이뤄졌다. 신한벤처투자와 공동으로 투자했다.디지털에셋은 금융사를 위한 프라이버시 블록체인 네트워크를 운영 중이다. 캔톤 네트워크는 퍼블릭 레이어1 블록체인으로 자산 등을 온체인 환경으로 이전하고 이 과정에서 프라이버시와 규제, 상호운용성을 구현하는 것이 특징이다.신한투자증권과 디지털에셋은 지난 6월 디지털자산과 토큰화 부문 협력을 위한 업무협약을 체결한 바 있다.신한투자증권은 이번 투자를 계기로 국내 기관투자자 대상 디지털자산 활용 기반 마련에 나설 방침이다.

title_en: Shinhan Investment & Securities invests in blockchain network company ‘Digital Asset’
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Shinhan Investment & Securities has begun investing in digital asset infrastructure. Shinhan Investment & Securities announced on the 27th that it has invested in Digital Asset, the operator of the blockchain network ‘Canton Network’. The investment amount is undisclosed. This investment was made by participating in a $355 million funding round led by a16z, a virtual asset fund. It was jointly invested with Shinhan Venture Investment. Digital Asset is operating a privacy blockchain network for financial companies. Canton Network is a public layer 1 blockchain that transfers assets to an on-chain environment and implements privacy, regulation, and interoperability in the process. Shinhan Investment & Securities and Digital Asset signed a business agreement for cooperation in the digital asset and tokenization sector last June. Shinhan Investment & Securities plans to use this investment as an opportunity to lay the foundation for the use of digital assets for domestic institutional investors.

title_ja: ダベンチャーズ、AI審査役「ビキ」導入…「投資検討の1日で終わる」
summary_ja: ベンチャーキャピタルダベンチャーズ（代表キム・チョルウ）は、AIで投資希望企業の事業計画書の検討結果を受けた後、24時間以内に配信するようにプロセスを改善したと27日明らかにした。昨年導入以来累積1500件以上の事業計画書を検討し、ビキと人間審査役の最終判断一致率は90%水準で高い精度を示した。
title_en: The Ventures introduces AI reviewer ‘Viki’… “Investment review is completed in one day”
summary_en: Venture capital firm The Ventures (CEO Kim Cheol-woo) announced on the 27th that it has improved its process to deliver the business plan review results of companies wishing to invest using AI within 24 hours after receiving them. The Ventures introduced its own AI review system 'Vicky', which learned investment data and follow-up management cases accumulated over the past 10 years. Since its introduction last year, a cumulative total of more than 1,500 business plans have been reviewed, and the final judgment agreement rate between Vicky and the human reviewer was high at 90%, showing high accuracy. Vicky was responsible for the first document review and performed business model analysis, data verification, and internal review report generation.

title_source: KAIST, ICML서 최우수논문상…‘세상 원리 이론화’하는 AI 선보여
summary_source: 한국과학기술원(KAIST, 총장 배충식)은 안성진 전산학부 교수 연구팀이 AI 관측 정보만으로 세계의 작동 원리를 스스로 이론화하도록 하는 새로운 학습 패러다임 ‘이론화 학습(L2T)’을 제안하고, 이를 구현한 신경망 이론 생성 모델 ‘네오(NEO)’를 개발했다고 27일 밝혔다.이번 연구는 지난 7월9일 서울에서 열린 ‘제43회 국제기계학습학회(ICML 2026)’에서 구두발표 논문으로 선정됐다. 전체 투고 논문 2만3918편 가운데 상위 0.7%(168편)에 해당하는 성과다. ‘구성적 학습 워크숍’에서도 최우수 논문상을 수상했다.
title_ja: KAIST、ICMLで最優秀論文賞… 「世界原理理論化」するAIを披露
summary_ja: 韓国科学技術院（KAIST、総長配虫式）は、アン・ソンジン電算学部教授の研究チームがAI観測情報だけで世界の作動原理を自ら理論化させる新しい学習パラダイム「理論化学習（L2T）」を提案し、これを具現したニューラルネットワーク理論生成モデル「ネオ（NEO）7」を開発した。ソウルで開かれた「第43回国際機械学習学会（ICML 2026）」で口頭発表論文に選ばれた。全体投稿論文2万3918編のうち上位0.7%(168編)に該当する成果だ。 「構成的学習ワークショップ」でも最優秀論文賞を受賞した。
title_en: KAIST wins best paper award at ICML... Introducing AI that ‘theorizes the principles of the world’
summary_en: The Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST, President Bae Chung-sik) announced on the 27th that Professor Ahn Seong-jin's research team in the Department of Computer Science proposed a new learning paradigm called ‘L2T (L2T)’, a new learning paradigm that allows people to theorize the operating principles of the world using only AI observation information, and developed a neural network theory generation model ‘NEO’ that implements this. This research was conducted at the ‘43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML)’ held in Seoul on July 9. 2026) was selected as an oral presentation paper. This is an achievement that ranks in the top 0.7% (168 papers) of the total 23,918 submitted papers. He also won the best paper award at the ‘Constructive Learning Workshop’.

title_en: NVIDIA pursues 365 trillion won in financial guarantee to build Open AI ‘10GW data center’
summary_en: NVIDIA is pursuing a plan to provide financial guarantees worth approximately $250 billion (approximately KRW 365 trillion) to support the construction of Open AI's ultra-large AI data center. The key is to strengthen credit so that OpenAI can lease a 10-gigawatt (GW) AI data center to be built in Ohio, USA. It is expected to be the largest AI computing infrastructure project in history, with a total project cost exceeding $500 billion (about 730 won). According to the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) on the 26th (local time), NVIDIA received 250 billion won in connection with the Ohio data center project being promoted by OpenAI and Softbank.
